h2. Description

*After a lead change, the "Lead technician updated" message should be a white rounded box with a green check-in-a-circle icon and an X to close it.* On staging it is a solid green box with white text and a Close button.

For example,
* the message reads "Lead technician updated" at the bottom right, which is right
* it is a solid green box with white text and a white check icon
* it has the word Close instead of an X

This appears inconsistent with the requirement defined in *Epic SV-10043* (Story *SV-10047*), the PRD and the design.

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Sign in to staging as an Admin, check the top bar shows *Staging Heavy Duty - 9919*, and use a browser window 1440 px wide at 100% zoom.
# Open *Work Orders*, click the *All* tab, then *Board View* in the display switcher (right side of the toolbar).
# Drag any Approved work order card from one technician's column into another's and release.
#* "Lead technician updated" shows at the bottom right as a solid green box with white text and *Close*.
#* After about ten seconds it goes by itself (which is right).

*Actual Result:*
* A solid green message box with white text and Close.

*Expected Result:*
* A white message box, as the test expects: *"Step 3: a white message box with rounded corners appears at the bottom right of the page, with a green check-in-a-circle icon, the words "Lead technician updated" and an X to close it, as in the design picture."*
